findings.title: Pipeline output is SVG primitives and SVG links, not PNG pixel assets
findings.statement: The assembler creates one rect per map cell, then emits SVG image elements pointing at five SVG files. The referenced files contain rect/path primitives and no PNG file exists under public/art/street-kit. shape-rendering=crispEdges preserves hard edges but does not establish a native PNG tileset or sprite blit pipeline.

findings.title: Footprint-sized image placement permits anisotropic stretch
findings.statement: The assembler sets image width and height to footprint cells times 16 and preserveAspectRatio=none. This can anisotropically stretch a source sprite and does not preserve native pixel dimensions or a transparent-sprite sampling contract. Current five intrinsic sizes match the corresponding footprint times 16; actual anisotropic stretch is not demonstrated for this snapshot.

findings.title: Tile IDs are palette lookup, not adjacency autotiling
findings.statement: The renderer maps tile values 0, 1, 2, 3 and 9 to five flat fills. No neighbor mask, corner case, material pair, bridge/bank rule or atlas frame selection is computed.

findings.title: Debug overlays are part of the canonical preview output
findings.statement: The canonical report records overlay=true and the assembled SVG includes grid paths, footprint rectangles, entrance circles, warp boxes and actor bounds. A clean output is only available by invoking the assembler with overlay=false; the checked-in preview is therefore a debug/structural preview rather than a clean visual production preview.

findings.title: Validator checks metadata and connectivity but not pixel or visual contracts
findings.statement: Validation covers IDs, paths, bytes, SHA-256, SVG dimensions, footprints, anchors, walkability, source-map parity, entrances and connectivity. It does not reject SVG-only production assets, inspect PNG bit depth/native sampling, test nearest-neighbor rendering, detect preserveAspectRatio=none, or prove autotile coverage.

findings.title: Donor point-cell connectivity misses full collider clearance
findings.statement: Donor mapping: west/east opening 32 high; collider y-22..y+16 height 38 cannot fit (anchor >=134 and <=128). Center anchors for F/P/s row 6 overlap blocked row 5. BFS and 10/10 tests do not establish full bounds. Runtime 48-world mapping and approval remain pending; no current runtime failure inferred.

findings.title: Visual QA shows readable blockout composition but insufficient pixel production detail
findings.statement: Four verified raster images were viewed at 320x240 and 4x integer enlargement; verified-render.json records the independent render and resolved linked asset hashes. They show a clear central cross-shaped route, two readable service buildings, one notice board and one bike rack. Grass, path and edge-stone materials are flat repeated clusters; water is absent in the street view and its visual QA remains pending for garden. Buildings are simple vector blockouts with broad facades and no demonstrated tall-sprite occlusion. Production PNG art and human art/camera approval remain pending; this raster is structural QA, not final pixel art.

findings.title: Six-map PNG coverage and runtime renderer remain unproven
findings.statement: The reviewed checkout contains six 20x15 map definitions but the reviewed street kit has no PNG terrain, building or prop library; six-map production PNG coverage and shared renderer are not established. Per-map asset needs, human palette approval and runtime consumption must remain pending until C/D/E execute their scoped work.
